Middleware runs before routing on every request, so Next designed it for the edge runtime: fast cold starts and execution close to the user. The cost is a restricted API surface, with no Node-only modules like fs. Newer Next versions can opt middleware into the Node runtime, but that depends on our version. Action: check the Next version in apps/web and whether it supports Node runtime middleware, and report back; I won't change the Clerk middleware.
